parsed_json.up: Select all IC50 activity rows in nM for human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, docs on doc_id, and compound_records on record_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
